_note: Hand-labeled synthetic FieldChange/MenuChange scenarios for contract_agent.py's decision layer (Good-to-Go's escalate/review classifier). Deliberately scoped to RULE-decided cases only -- no GEMINI_API_KEY needed, fully deterministic, no network dependency, same testing philosophy as labeled_cases.json for agent.py's own eval. Genuinely ambiguous free-text changes (an event_type reword, a menu description edit) go through llm_client.judge_contract_change() instead of a rule and aren't covered here -- see docs/DESIGN.md's Limitations section for why LLM-judged paths are validated by manual review rather than an automated eval.

cases.why: location is an always-escalate field -- delivery/logistics depend on it directly, regardless of magnitude
event_time is an always-escalate field, same reasoning as location
5% increase, below the significant-change threshold -- still shown, just not urgent
a field with real content going blank is treated as a likely extraction miss, always escalated by rule ahead of every other check
any menu item added is escalated unconditionally, regardless of magnitude
any menu item removed is escalated unconditionally
a quantity/unit change on an existing item is a rule-decidable prep-volume fact, always escalated
